Stellarium 描述: The Tupi name for this constellation is Iandutim (Guirá Nhandu in Guarani), which literally translates to White Ostrich. The constellation depicts a large bird. In the first two weeks of June this constellation is fully visible in the Eastern sky in the evening, indicating the beginning of Winter in the South of Brazil, and the start of the dry season in the North.
